On Borneo the majority of collections have occured from the Kapuas River basin in the Indonesian province of West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat). It also occurs in the neighbouring Malaysian state of Sarawak and there exist numerous records from the Belait and Ingei Rivers, Belait District, Brunei Darussalam.
